class.name: SumPoints
class.brief_description: Node Class that finds all the [Tractable] nodes in the scene and sums their points to [code]total_points[/code]
class.description: This class uses a deptwise search in [code]traveser_children()[/code] to find all the nodes in the scene. In [method _ready] the results are looped over, and if the class matches [Tractable] then the code gets property [code]Points[/code] and adds it to [code]total_points[/code].

members.member: The number of points to award the player when the item is successfully collected.
A reference to the [RigidBody3D] of the object. Stored internally as an ObjectID.
A reference to the PackedScene containing the particles to be emitted when the Tractable is collected. The scene is spawned at the current posititon in [method collect].

return.description: Used when the object is collected. Deletes the object and returns the number of points to be collected.

Used to add a force to the object's [Rigidbody3D] using a [Vector3] [code]global_position[/code] representing the global position of the force and a [Vector3] [code]direction[/code] representing the direction of action of the force of strength [code]force[/code].

Used to add a force to the object's [Rigidbody3D] using a [Vector3] [code]local_position[/code] representing the local position of the force and a [Vector3] [code]direction[/code] representing the direction of action of the force of strength [code]force[/code].
